newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - NORTHEASTERN CLINTON CSD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - NORTHEASTERN CLINTON CSD, N.Y..

text.p: Northeastern Clinton Central School District at Champlain,

Sealed bids for the above-captioned bonds will be received by the Northeastern Clinton Central School District at Champlain, New York (the School District''), at the offices of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey L.L.P., 350 Park Avenue, 15th Floor, New York, New York 10022 until 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time, on

at which time and place the bids will be opened for the purchase at not less than par and accrued interest of $5,138,000 aggregate principal amount Northeastern Clinton Central School District at Champlain, New York, School District Serial Bonds, Series 1997, dated September 1, 1997, bearing interest payable semi-annually on March 1 and September 1 commencing March 1, 1998, and maturing on September 1 in the years and corresponding principal amounts which are expected to provide substantially level debt service as specified in the Notice of Sale, as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds maturing on or after September 1, 2008 are subject to redemption, at the option of the School District, prior to maturity on or after September 1, 2007 at the prices and on the terms more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement. Such bids will be opened in public at said time and place on said day for the purchase of the Bonds. The Bonds will be subject to redemption as specified in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be awarded pursuant to the method set forth in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are general obligations of the School District and will be secured by the full faith and credit of the School District, all as more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement. The

approving opinion of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey L.L.P., Bond Counsel, will be furnished to the successful bidder at the expense of the School District. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the

Notice of Sale and the Proposal Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the Financial Advisor to the School District, Munistat Services, Inc., 12 Roosevelt Avenue, Port Jefferson Station, New York 11776 (516-331-8888). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form (not a photocopy thereof)
contained in the Notice of Sale and Proposal Form. The will be delivered on or about September 8, 1997.
Dated: August 7, 1997 President of the Board of Education
